vv69:2.1: tathūpamaṃ tuyham idaṃ vimānaṃ obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati antalikkhe. [=69].2 Deviddhipatto 'si mahānubhāvo manussabhūto kim
vv69:3.1: akāsi puññaṃ kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo vaṇṇo
vv69:3.2: ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. [=69].3 So devaputto attamano Moggallānena pucchito pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. [=69].4 Ahañ ca bhariyā ca manussaloke upassayaṃ arahato adamha annañ ca pānañ ca pasannacittā sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adamha. [=69].5 Tena m' etādiso vaṇṇo tena me idha-m-ijjhati uppajjanti ca me bhogā ye keci manaso piyā. [=69].6 Akkhāmi te bhikkhu mahānubhāva manussabhūto yam akāsi puññaṃ ten' amhi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo
vv69:3.3: vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti.
